---
name: Suggest a check or detector
about: A launch mistake Ship Kit should check for, or a way to auto-detect an existing check
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**The check**
What should Ship Kit check for, in plain terms? Who does it apply to?

**Why it matters**
The real problem it prevents. A concrete example of it going wrong is ideal.

**Can it be auto-detected?**
If yes, what in the code or on the live site would reveal whether it is done?
